items.title: Two-sided glueing of one-dimensional Noetherian semi-local domains whose tensor product maps onto the common field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for two one-dimensional Noetherian semi-local domains A, B inside a common field K with A tensor B mapping onto K, the spectra of A and B are open subschemes covering Spec(R) and K equals A tensor_R B. The proof starts with the special case where B is integrally closed in K, i.e. B is Dedekind with maximal ideals m_1, ..., m_r, and builds the intermediate ring R_1 = A times_K B_{m_1}, verifying that the tensor product over R_1 with the localization still maps onto K and then descending the open-immersion statements to R (proof lines 7459-7466 and the following body up to line 7506). H2: the construction of the intermediate ring and the verification of the tensor product surjectivity are the substance; the general case is then reduced to the integrally closed one.
